rules.description: Music stutters, stops after a few seconds, or pauses when screen locks or during playback.
troubleshooting_sequence: Check network stability: toggle WiFi or test playback over cellular data
On Desktop: disable 'Hardware Acceleration' under Spotify Settings -> Advanced Settings
On Mobile: verify Spotify is not set to 'Battery Optimization' or restricted in Background App Refresh
Log out of Spotify, reboot device, and log back in to clear cache session

rules.description: Track plays on scrubber bar but no audio comes out of speakers or headphones.
troubleshooting_sequence: Check device volume and system sound output preferences
Toggle Spotify Connect icon at bottom right to verify correct active playback speaker
Restart Spotify client to release locked audio drivers

rules.description: Playback pauses because another device started streaming on the same account.
troubleshooting_sequence: Individual Premium accounts only support single-stream playback at one time
If you suspect unauthorized streaming, visit spotify.com/account and click 'Sign out everywhere'
Update account password immediately after signing out
